messages:
ryan: Anyone hit generator.Stream abruptly ending when we rotate creds mid-run in the onboarding sample?
jess: Yup. Repro is simple: start a long stream, rotate tokens, sample recreates http.Client -> TLS/conn teardown -> iterator stops.
ryan: Error we saw: "rpc error: code = Canceled desc = stream terminated by peer". New users think stream finished normally.
jess: The fix for the sample: keep one transport and inject token at request time. Minimal RoundTripper pattern: 
```go
rt := &AuthRT{Base: http.DefaultTransport, TokenFunc: func() string { return token.Load().(string) }}
client := &http.Client{Transport: rt}
// update token.Store(newToken) on refresh
```
No client recreation, no connection churn.
ryan: SDK-side thought: return typed errors (ErrStreamAuthRotate / ErrStreamConnReset) or provide helper StreamWithAuthRefresh that retries once or surfaces clear error. New users copy sample and get confused.
jess: Agreed. I'll open a docs PR updating onboarding snippets and add a short note: "If you must recreate client on refresh, cancel ongoing iterators and restart them."
devex-bot: created DEVEX-1142: go-sdk onboarding: token-hot-swap sample + typed stream errors (link) :white_check_mark:
